# Stickercast

> Google Ads management for independent healthcare practices in the United States.
> One flat monthly fee — $497 or $997 USD — never a percentage of ad spend.
> The first month of management is free; billing starts in month two.
> Month to month, no setup fee, and the Google Ads account belongs to the practice.

Stickercast builds and runs paid search campaigns for independent medical, dental
and therapy practices. We do one channel — Google Ads — rather than a bundle of
services. Campaigns are built inside the client's own Google Ads account, so every
keyword, conversion record and year of performance history stays with the practice.

## Pricing (published, not quote-only)

| Plan     | Price        | Covers                                                    |
|----------|--------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
| Practice | $497 USD/mo  | One campaign, one location                                 |
| Multi    | $997 USD/mo  | Unlimited campaigns, up to 3 locations, call recording     |

The fee is flat and does not change with ad budget. Google ad spend is billed
separately by Google, directly to the practice, and none of it comes to Stickercast.
No setup fee. No minimum term. 30 days notice to cancel.

FIRST MONTH FREE. On either plan, the first month of management costs nothing.
Stickercast builds the campaigns, installs conversion tracking and runs the account
for a full month before charging anything; billing begins in month two. During the
free month the practice still pays Google directly for ad clicks — that is the only
cost, and none of it goes to Stickercast. The rationale: month one is setup plus
Google's learning period, so it is the month with the least performance to show.

Comparison: the industry standard is 15–20% of ad spend, often with a $1,000–1,500
monthly minimum. At $10,000/month in ad spend that is $1,500–2,000 in fees for the
same work Stickercast does for $497.

## What is included

- Campaign build or rebuild in the client's own Google Ads account
- Conversion tracking for phone calls and form submissions, verified working
- A dedicated landing page, hosted and maintained
- Weekly search-term review and negative keyword management
- Ad copy written and tested against the practice's actual services
- Monthly plain-English report: enquiries, cost per enquiry, what changed

Not included: the ad spend itself, website rebuilds, SEO, social media, email
marketing, or any guaranteed number of patients.

## Specialties

Stickercast builds around three specialties, each with a dedicated page:

- Dermatology — /for-dermatology.html
- Physical therapy — /for-physical-therapy.html
- Dental — /for-dental.html

Other outpatient specialties are taken on where the campaign mechanics are similar.
Stickercast does not work with hospital systems.

## US healthcare search benchmarks used throughout the site

Source: LocaliQ healthcare search advertising benchmarks, updated January 2026,
based on 3,542 US campaigns running October 2024 to September 2025. Medians, USD.

| Specialty            | Cost per click | Conversion rate | Cost per lead |
|----------------------|----------------|-----------------|---------------|
| Dermatology          | $4.90          | 25.3%           | $18.54        |
| Ophthalmology        | $4.32          | 14.0%           | $30.88        |
| Physical therapy     | $4.95          | 15.4%           | $32.79        |
| All healthcare       | $5.64          | 8.09%           | $66.02        |
| General dentistry    | $7.03          | 7.7%            | $84.77        |
| Plastic surgery      | $8.41          | 8.2%            | $102.51       |

Dermatology is the most efficient of sixteen healthcare specialties benchmarked.
General dentistry is among the most expensive.

## Results — stated with their limits

One client account. An independent family practice running a walk-in clinic one day
a week. Over four days of advertising: $185.72 ad spend, 44 clicks, 8 patient
enquiries, $23.22 per enquiry, 18.2% conversion rate.

Important qualifications, which appear on the results page itself:
- Sample is 44 clicks — small enough that ordinary variation moves the percentages.
- One of the four days produced six of the eight enquiries. Excluding that day,
  the conversion rate falls to 3.2%.
- There is NO before-and-after comparison. Before this campaign the practice had no
  conversion tracking at all; patient enquiries were very likely occurring in earlier
  months and simply were not counted. Stickercast makes no claim to have increased
  enquiry volume. What changed is that the number became measurable.

Stickercast does not publish aggregate client results or percentage-improvement
claims, because it does not have the client volume to support them honestly.

## Common questions

**Who owns the Google Ads account?** The practice. Campaigns run inside the client's
own account. Nothing is held on a proprietary platform.

**Why flat fee instead of percentage of spend?** Percentage pricing gives an agency a
financial reason to push budgets higher and charges more for identical work as a
practice grows. A flat fee removes that incentive.

**Is there a contract?** No. Month to month, 30 days notice.

**What does the free audit include?** A written review of the existing Google Ads
account — wasted search terms, whether conversion tracking works, cost per lead
against US benchmarks for the specialty, and the three changes we would make first.
Delivered in 2–3 business days. Free, no obligation, and the practice keeps it.

**What if the practice isn't running ads yet?** A build plan instead: keywords worth
bidding on locally, realistic CPC and CPL for the specialty, and a sensible starting
budget.

**Is the first month genuinely free?** Yes. No management fee in month one on either
plan, and no setup fee at any point. The practice pays Google for ad clicks during
that month. Billing from Stickercast starts in month two, and can be cancelled with
30 days notice at any time after that.

**Why offer a free month?** Stickercast has a single published client result drawn
from a small sample and says so openly on its results page. The free month exists so
a prospective client can generate their own data rather than relying on that one
account.
